subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story : 18=8 (a) One day, he became very hungry and could not get anything to eat. (b) The food was very hot. (c) He came to a house and asked an old woman to give him something to eat. (d) As a result, he burnt his finger. (e) He hurriedly dug his fingers right at the middle of the dish. (f) Then he disguised himself as a poor traveller and supported himself by begging. (g) Once young Taimur attacked a province of a powerful prince but unfortunately all his soldiers were killed. (h) The old woman fell pity for him and quickly gave Taimur a dish full of food.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
